recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x prior middle/base lower single), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through the first divergent lower-card single is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. The application module is stubbed, and only the immediate top/index-0 whole-group single=false rotation is retained as the measured transition.

included: forty-eight independently constructed marker-free histories, executed as separate ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case captures

local/opponent active and sole-bench histories beginning from an unrefreshed clean top-driven group q1/q2/q3 state, followed by exactly one middle/base single=true reset and an immediate top/index-0 whole-group single=false rotation

exact pre-state inheritance from the matching compound-lower-nonzero-group-single-v1 post-state, including turns, BREAK flags, margins, stack/card rectangles, ten hit probes, and the full operation-trace prefix
the measured top whole-group branch advancing every Pokemon one quarter-turn while preserving all per-card BREAK flags, including the selected lower card remaining false

the successor-turn collision: post turns equal checkpoint-21 q2/q3 posts for original q1/q2 and the homogeneous history-authored-q0 post for original q3, while the selected lower BREAK flag and full traces differ
digest-pinned active/bench plain-R ingress and clicked-top-to-zone/index-0 selection, without executing the application keydown listener

exact measured-transition trace, initiator-dependent inline margins, topology and links, painted/authored/physical geometry, ten native hit probes and orders, stable identifiers, observer ownership, and cleanup
excluded: pristine or coherent whole-group rotation without the immediately preceding clean nonzero-group lower-card single transition
lower-initiated group rotation, a second same- or other-lower-card single before the measured group rotation, repeated measured group rotations, and already-BREAK or raw/imported lower states
q1-refreshed, returned/history-authored, lower-initiated, imported, replayed, restored, or moved nonzero-group pre-state histories
refresh, movement, promotion, evolution/removal, leaveAll, undo, replay, or wrapper reconstruction after the first divergent lower-card transition
normalizing per-evolution turns, BREAK flags, or wrapper-margin history into canonical v2 state, commands, rendering, or UX
converted categories, non-Pokemon initiators, Energy, Trainer, Tool, markers/counters, attachments, mixed dimensions, and noncanonical assets
additional bench siblings, flex shrink, overflow, resize-driven layout, explicit flip, fullscreen, alternate viewport/DPR, and concealment
application/network execution, candidate parity, and production/domain/protocol/schema geometry
